newsitem.title: UK: Wave of new orders cited on sugar freight market.
newsitem.headline: Wave of new orders cited on sugar freight market.

text.p: The sugar freight market saw a spate of fresh inquiry at the start of the week with Cuba, Mexico and Thailand most in demand as origins, shipbrokers said on Monday.
Jean Lion provided the day's only reported fixture with 30/31,500 tonnes of bulk sugar from Cuba to Iran for the end of April.
Shipbrokers said Louis Dreyfus was on subjects with 12,000 tonnes in bulk from Thailand to Japan for mid-April.
Dreyfus also quoted for 12,000 tonnes in bags from Puerto Quetzal to Yemen for April 9/15.
It also quoted for 25,000 tonnes in bulk from Cuba to Black Sea/Baltic for April 10/20 or later.
Cuba was also popular with Lorico with Middle East and north African nations as buyers.
Lorico quoted for 28/30,000 tonnes to Egypt for May 1/7 and 13,000 tonnes to Syria for the same shipment dates.

E D & F Man quoted for 13,300/14,700 tonnes min/max preslung bagged sugar from north Spain to Iran for April 9/16 and a further 14/15,475 tonnes, also in bags, from Dunkirk or Le Havre to Iraq's Umm Qasr for April 14/22.
It was also open for 3,960/6,000 tonnes in bags from east coast Mexico to Angola for prompt/seven days. Man's recent Guatemalan order to Colombo was still uncovered.
Shipbrokers said Kerry Trading was open for 11,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Thailand to Indonesai for mid-April.
Secretan also issued a number of bagged orders, mainly from European origins.
Algeria featured in two of the orders, for 12/13,000 tonnes from Dunkirk for prompt/April 18 and 3,000 tonnes from Manfredonia for spot/onwards.
Secretan also quoted for 6/10,000 tonnes from Continent to Lagos for spot/onwards dates and 14,000 tonnes from Recife to Lagos for April 21/25.
Cargill was open for 14,000 tonnes min/max in bags from France/Netherlands/Belgium to Lagos for April 14/18.
Benham or nominee was open for 10,000 tonnes in bulk from Belize to St John for April 17/27 and 14/24,000 tonnes from Punta Morales to Toronto for April 15/25.
CSC quoted for up to 12,800 tonnes of bulk sugar from Trinidad to US Gulf/Atlantic for prompt/onwards and for a 20/22,000 tonnes from La Romana to Crockett for April 10/20.
